content: Yeremiyahu n’ebinwa by’endagâno
Akanwa Yeremiyahu abwîragwa na Nyakasane:
«Obwîre abantu b’omu ishwa lya Yûda n’ab’omu Yeruzalemu.
“Obabwîre erhi: Yekudesire Nyakasane Nyamuzinda w’Israheli erhi: akahera omuntu orhumva ebinwa by’eyi ndagâno”,
“binwa narhegekaga basho olusiku mbakûla omu cibeye, omu cihugo c’e Mîsiri”». Nababwîra nti «muyumve izù lyâni; munajire ngasi kwoshi nâkamurhegeka lyo mubà lubaga lwâni, nâni mbè Nyamuzinda winyu.
“Kuderha nti nyunjulize gulya mulagi nalahiraga nti ntagujiriri basho gulya gw’okubahà ishwa lyahululamwo amarhà n’obûci, nk’oku biri buno”». Nâni nashuza nti: «Nêci, Nyamwagirwa».
Na Nyakasane anacimbwîra erhi: «omu bishagala bya Yûda n’omu mihanda ya Yeruzalemu oyâkûze mpu: muyumve ebinwa by’eyi ndagâno munabijire.
“Bulyâla narhonzire basho erhi mbakûla e Mîsiri, na kuhika buno nadesire buzira kurhama nti: muyumve izù lyâni.”.

“Cikwône barhumvagya barhaderhaga mpu barhege okurhwiri, ngasi muguma ayêrekera emunda omurhima gwâge mubî gunayêrekire. Okubundi nabakolera akal’ibala ebinwa by’eyi ndagâno byoshi byanali bidesire, binwa nali mbasêzize okushimba barhanabishimbaga.”».
Nyakasane ambwîra erhi: Bene Yûda n’ab’omu Yeruzalemu banywânane.

Bashubirire amaligo ga b’îshe, balahiraga mpu barhayumva ebinwa byâni: b’abôla bakulikîre banyamuzinda b’obwîhambi mpu babè bo bakolera. Enyumpa y’Israheli n’enyumpa ya Yûda bavunyire omu binwa by’endagâno rhwalagânanaga rhwe na b’îshe.
Co cirhumirage, Yekudesire Nyakasane, lâba oku nkola nabarhumira obuhanya barhafume, bakanyâkûza, ntabashuze.
Go mango ebishagala bya Yûda n’ab’omu Yeruzalemu bajigashâniza n’enshangi banyamuzinda b’obwîhambi. Abo banyamuzinda barhabarhabâle ciru n’ehitya amango g’obuhanya.
Bulyâla wâni Yûda, banyamuzinda bâwe kwo bali banji nka ebishagala byâwe.
N’oku emihanda ya Yeruzalemu eri minji kwo nazo ziri nyinji empêrero wayûbasire z’okugashâniza Baali.
Abakomera aka-Nyamuzinda batumuzibwa
Omusîmwa wâni bici alijira omu mwâni? Anayunjulize obulonza bwâge bubî. Ewe k’emihigo n’enyama nterekêre byo byakurhenza mw’obu buhanya olimo ly’omanya oku wacîshinga?
Muzêti guyanyire gunajagalîre, lyo izîno Nyakasane ali akuhîre; lêro ahizirage omuiiro omu byâsi byâwe; n’amashami gabôyôsire.
Na Nyakasane w’Emirhwe wakugwîkaga, akutwîrîre olufù n’ecarhumire, ganali amaligo enyumpa y’Israheli n’eya Yûda zakozire mpu banjire burhè omu kududûkiza Baali omugî gw’enshangi.
Yeremiyahu alibuzibwa e Anatoti
Nyamubâho anali erhi antonzire: nayôrha mmanyire! Ago mango, Nyakasane, wanzibûla amasù mpu gabone ebi balimwo!
Niehe kwo nali nka mwâna-buzi
wajibagwa, erhi ntanamanyiri emirali bagwêrhe kuli nie. Mpu «rhuhongole omurhi gujinire, rhumukûle omu igulu ly’abazîne, irhondo izîno lyâge lirhakengêragwa»!
Cikwône wêhe, Nyakasane w’Emirhwe, we twa emmanja n’obushinganyanya we singiriza ensiko n’omurhima onyêreke mbone oku wacîhôlerabo bulya we ntûzire olubanja lwâni.
Okwo kwo kurhumire, ntya kwo Nyakasane aderhîre abantu b’e Anatoti bashimbire omûka gwâni: «Erhi orhajiraga obulêbi oku izîno lya Nyakasane, lyo orhagiyîrhwa n’enfune zîrhu».
Lâba oku niono nk’ola najibarhangula. Emisole yâbo, ngôrho yabayîrha, bagala bâbo na bâli bâbo bafà n’ishali.
Barhabemwo owasigala hano ndîkira obuhanya omu bantu b’e Anatoti.
